our_interpretation: Assess the benchmark comparison displayed in the announcement figure referenced on May 13, 2024.
The ordinary reading is that the depicted performance gains are generally modest in both adjacent comparisons.
This does not claim that speed, price, voice interaction, or every other capability changed little.
No numerical cutoff or weighting of benchmarks is supplied. Inspect the size and distribution of differences without inventing an aggregate score.
criteria.support_condition: The identified figure shows generally modest differences both between GPT-4o and GPT-4 Turbo and between GPT-4 Turbo and the original GPT-4.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The identified figure shows substantial improvements across several displayed measures in either comparison. If one comparison holds and the other does not, propose mixed.
